paragraphs: Rav Menashya bar Gada: [Sukkah 13b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.13b.7), in Rav Huna’s time.[^1]

notes.text: In the linked Gemara, Rav Menashya bar Gada rules in Rav Huna’s name about grain cut for roofing. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2519&lang=en) records the same transmission. Hyman dates Rav Menashya to Rav Huna’s time.
